page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and provides 8.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application deployment. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated Intel Xeon processor, the ecs.hfg8i.large is suitable for general-purpose workloads, light web serving, microservices, and small-scale application hosting where consistent CPU performance is required.
